patterns.limits_en: There is no global sender-clock ordering, exactly-once delivery or automatic rollback. Retrying add after a lost reply may duplicate the effect.

patterns.summary_ru: Map порождает ключи, shuffle направляет их владельцам, reduce объединяет значения по ключу.
patterns.summary_en: Map emits keys, shuffle routes them to owners, and reduce combines values per key.
patterns.scenario_ru: Две входные части [1,2] и [3,4] группируются по чётности. Map выдаёт (n mod 2,1); reduce считает элементы.
patterns.scenario_en: Two partitions [1,2] and [3,4] are grouped by parity. Map emits (n mod 2,1); reduce counts values.
patterns.expected_ru: Результат {0:2,1:2}. Чтение итогов выполняется после четырёх подтверждённых reduce-операций.
patterns.expected_en: Result {0:2,1:2}. Final reads occur after four acknowledged reduce operations.

Partition items are mailed to their mapper. barrier.accepted(int):void counts four semantic add replies; only then does the host read both reducers. post grouping does not imply a barrier. Go/Erlang use one reducer for both keys: the same aggregation with different placement. ReducerMessage reuses its read after changing count; the mapper, separate owners and barrier acknowledgements are unchanged.
patterns.comparison_ru: LMX выражает shuffle явным выбором Message-владельца ключа; Go channel и Erlang mail переносят ключи. Это раскрывает алгоритм map/group/reduce, но ещё не распределённый движок Google MapReduce.
patterns.comparison_en: LMX expresses shuffle as explicit selection of the key owner Message; Go channels and Erlang mail carry keys. This exposes map/group/reduce without claiming to implement the distributed Google MapReduce engine.
patterns.limits_ru: Нет spill-to-disk, сбойного перезапуска map, dedup, сортировки ключей и durable shuffle. Неотрицательные целые ограничены четырьмя значениями; порядок обработки не влияет на сумму.
patterns.limits_en: There is no disk spill, failed-map restart, deduplication, key sorting or durable shuffle. The fixture uses four nonnegative integers; processing order does not affect the count.

patterns.name: Request-Response / Ask
patterns.summary_ru: Запрос завершается поздним reply либо deadline; owner продолжает обслуживать сообщения.
patterns.summary_en: A request finishes through a later reply or deadline while its owner continues serving messages.
patterns.scenario_ru: Один запрос с token=1 истекает. После этого начинается token=2. Поздний reply token=1 игнорируется; reply token=2 со значением 12 принимается. Query обслуживается при active=1.
patterns.scenario_en: Request token 1 expires, then token 2 starts. A late reply for token 1 is ignored; token 2 accepts value 12. Query remains serviceable while active.
patterns.expected_ru: Для token=1 один terminal timeout, для token=2 один результат 12; повторный reply/deadline не создаёт нового результата. Busy и исчерпание i64 counter дают отдельный отказ.
patterns.expected_en: Token 1 has one terminal timeout and token 2 one result 12; repeated replies/deadlines create no further result. Busy and i64 counter exhaustion are separate rejections.
patterns.comparison_ru: LMX показывает post/answer и owner state; Go — тот же автомат в channel loop с явными nonblocking Compute/Schedule ports; Erlang — process receive и send_after. Это прикладное управление deadline, а не новый блокирующий ask primitive.
patterns.comparison_en: LMX shows post/answer and owner state, Go the same state machine in a channel loop with nonblocking Compute/Schedule ports, and Erlang receive/send_after. This is application deadline policy, not a new blocking ask primitive.
patterns.limits_ru: Один in-flight request на экземпляр; durable retries, exactly-once effect, service cancellation и общий multiplexed pending map не обещаны. Token counter не переиспользуется; новая owner identity отделяет следующий запуск. Все значения примера малы и не переполняют арифметику service.
patterns.limits_en: One in-flight request per instance. No durable retry, exactly-once effect, service cancellation or general multiplexed pending map. Tokens are not reused; a new owner identity separates restarts. Fixture values do not overflow service arithmetic.

Message itself does not introduce deadlock; no blocking thread wait or LMX synchronized is added. post already binds addressed exchange and correlation. token/epoch are application deadline or resource-generation data, not a second scheduler. events is a nonblocking owner-local observation sink, never a synchronous call into another Message.     ask_loop(Service, Observer, Delay, 0, 0, false).
ask_loop(Service, Observer, Delay, Next, Current, Active) ->
    receive
        {start, _} when Active ->
            Observer ! {rejected, 1},
            ask_loop(Service, Observer, Delay, Next, Current, Active);
        {start, _} when Next =:= 9223372036854775807 ->
            Observer ! {rejected, 2},
            ask_loop(Service, Observer, Delay, Next, Current, Active);
        {start, Value} ->
            Token = Next + 1,
            erlang:send_after(Delay, self(), {expire, Token}),
            Service ! {compute, self(), Token, Value},
            ask_loop(Service, Observer, Delay, Token, Token, true);
        {computed, Current, Value} when Active ->
            Observer ! {finished, Current, false, Value},
            ask_loop(Service, Observer, Delay, Next, Current, false);
        {expire, Current} when Active ->
            Observer ! {finished, Current, true, 0},
            ask_loop(Service, Observer, Delay, Next, Current, false);

            Observer ! {status, Active, Current},
            ask_loop(Service, Observer, Delay, Next, Current, Active);

    end.

selective(Observer) -> selective_loop(Observer, 0, []).
selective_loop(Observer, Phase, Queue) ->
    receive
        {work, Id, _} when Phase =:= 2 ->
            Observer ! {rejected, Id, 2},
            selective_loop(Observer, Phase, Queue);
        {work, Id, Value} when Phase =:= 1, Queue =:= [] ->
            Observer ! {finished, Id, Value * 2},
            selective_loop(Observer, Phase, Queue);
        {work, Id, _} when length(Queue) =:= 2 ->
            Observer ! {rejected, Id, 1},
            selective_loop(Observer, Phase, Queue);
        {work, Id, Value} ->
            case Phase of 1 -> self() ! pump; _ -> ok end,
            selective_loop(Observer, Phase, Queue ++ [{Id, Value}]);
        {become, Mode} when Phase =/= 2, (Mode =:= 0 orelse Mode =:= 1) ->
            case {Mode, Queue} of {1, [_|_]} -> self() ! pump; _ -> ok end,
            selective_loop(Observer, Mode, Queue);
        pump when Phase =:= 1, Queue =/= [] ->
            [{Id, Value}|Rest] = Queue,
            Observer ! {finished, Id, Value * 2},
            case Rest of [] -> ok; _ -> self() ! pump end,
            selective_loop(Observer, Phase, Rest);
        {reply, Id, Value} ->
            Observer ! {reply_seen, Id, Value},
            selective_loop(Observer, Phase, Queue);
        query ->
            Observer ! {status, Phase, length(Queue)},
            selective_loop(Observer, Phase, Queue);
        stop when Phase =/= 2 ->
            [Observer ! {rejected, Id, 2} || {Id, _} <- Queue],
            Observer ! stopped,
            selective_loop(Observer, 2, []);
        terminate -> ok;
        _ -> selective_loop(Observer, Phase, Queue)
    end.

            phase_loop(A,B,RA,RB,Observer,Gen,P,D,Stopped,F);
        {'DOWN', Ref, process, Pid, _} when Phase =:= 2,
              ((Ref =:= RA andalso Pid =:= A) orelse
               (Ref =:= RB andalso Pid =:= B)) ->
            S = Stopped#{Ref => true},
            case map_size(S) of
                2 -> Observer ! {finished, not Failed}, ok;
                _ -> phase_loop(A,B,RA,RB,Observer,Gen,Phase,Drained,S,Failed)
            end;
        query ->
            Observer ! {status, Phase, 2-map_size(Drained), 2-map_size(Stopped)},
            phase_loop(A,B,RA,RB,Observer,Gen,Phase,Drained,Stopped,Failed);
        _ -> phase_loop(A,B,RA,RB,Observer,Gen,Phase,Drained,Stopped,Failed)
    end.
phase_child(Id, Gen, Observer, Flush, Release) ->
    phase_child_loop(Id,Gen,Observer,Flush,Release,0,undefined).
phase_child_loop(Id,Gen,Observer,Flush,Release,Phase,Parent) ->
    receive
        {work, Value} when Phase =:= 0 ->
            Observer ! {value, Value*2},
            phase_child_loop(Id,Gen,Observer,Flush,Release,Phase,Parent);
        {work, _} ->
            Observer ! rejected,
            phase_child_loop(Id,Gen,Observer,Flush,Release,Phase,Parent);
        {drain, From, Gen} when Phase =:= 0 ->
            Flush(Gen, self()),
            phase_child_loop(Id,Gen,Observer,Flush,Release,1,From);
        {flushed, Gen, OK} when Phase =:= 1 ->
            Release(), Parent ! {drained, Id, Gen, OK},
            phase_child_loop(Id,Gen,Observer,Flush,Release,2,Parent);
        query ->
            Observer ! {child_status,Id,Phase},
            phase_child_loop(Id,Gen,Observer,Flush,Release,Phase,Parent);
        stop when Phase =:= 2 -> ok;
        _ -> phase_child_loop(Id,Gen,Observer,Flush,Release,Phase,Parent)
    end.
listings.notes_ru: Parent и children — отдельные процессы. Parent использует настоящие monitors и сверяет monitor reference вместе с PID. Flush — явно поставленный async native adapter; Release вызывается после completion. Child не вызывает блокирующий stop своего supervisor.
listings.notes_en: Parent and children are separate ordinary processes. Parent uses real process monitors and matches both monitor reference and PID. Flush is an explicitly supplied asynchronous native adapter, Release returns after completed flush cleanup. No child calls a blocking parent supervisor stop.

patterns.name: External Blocking Adapter
patterns.summary_ru: Физический блокирующий вызов вынесен в native L2 worker; LMX получает обычный Message completion.
patterns.summary_en: A physically blocking call runs in a native L2 worker; LMX receives an ordinary Message completion.
patterns.scenario_ru: Принять один native job, обслужить query, начать close, отклонить новые jobs. Native completion возвращает действительный ok/value после освобождения native holds; затем owner освобождает idle adapter и закрывается.
patterns.scenario_en: Admit one native job, serve query, begin close and reject new jobs. A native completion reports real ok/value after releasing native holds; then the owner releases the idle adapter and closes.
patterns.expected_ru: Пока native call не завершён, active=1 и query обслуживается. beginClose не считает job завершённым. Один completion даёт один итог; stale token ничего не меняет; releaseIdle и close происходят только при active=0.
patterns.expected_en: While the native call runs, active is one and query remains serviceable. beginClose does not mark the job complete. One completion yields one result; a stale token changes nothing. releaseIdle/close occur only when inactive.
patterns.comparison_ru: Go запускает ровно одну goroutine с действительным supplied blocking function и bounded completion channel; Erlang запускает отдельный процесс, а native Call обязан быть port либо корректно dirty-scheduled NIF. Сам spawn не делает произвольный блокирующий NIF безопасным. LMX-автомат не маскирует отсутствие физического adapter.
patterns.comparison_en: Go starts one goroutine with the supplied blocking function and a bounded completion channel. Erlang starts a process, but native Call must use a port or correctly dirty-scheduled NIF; spawn alone does not make an arbitrary blocking NIF safe. The LMX state machine does not hide its missing physical adapter.
patterns.limits_ru: Один job и один owner. Hard worker crash требует отдельного failure completion либо явного unknown outcome от host; force-kill native thread и подтверждённая отмена не обещаны. В данном fixture call в итоге возвращает либо выдаёт перехваченный failure. Числовой value при ok=0 не считается успешным результатом.
patterns.limits_en: One job and owner. Hard worker crash requires a separate failure completion or explicit unknown outcome; force-killing a native thread and confirmed cancellation are not promised. This fixture's call eventually returns or raises a captured failure. A value with ok=false is inactive.
patterns.lmx_notes_ru: Исполняемые экземпляры создаются штатным R0/Message host profile. Message не вводит deadlock; синхронного ожидания потока и LMX synchronized здесь нет. post сам связывает адресованный обмен и корреляцию. Поля token/epoch относятся к прикладному deadline или поколению ресурса, не реализуют второй scheduler. events — nonblocking owner-local observer для проверяемого trace; он не обращается синхронно к чужому Message. Физические timer/lifecycle/native adapters остаются REQUIRE_IMPLEMENTATION. LMX parser/type/runtime: NOT_RUN. native.submit(token,value,selfAddress):int — узкая L2/host граница: 1 означает admission, 0 отказ без запуска. Она копирует вход, удерживает ресурсы и немедленно возвращается; blocking I/O, C API locks и OS waits исполняются только вне Message owner в выбранном native executor/process. completed(token,ok,value) публикуется после возврата native call и освобождения его holds, не синхронным callback в submit. releaseIdle допустим лишь после последнего completion. c.* и физические synchronization primitives остаются L2. Успешная admission не является successful job result.
patterns.lmx_notes_en: Executable instances use the ordinary R0/Message host profile. Message itself does not introduce deadlock; no blocking thread wait or LMX synchronized is added. post already binds addressed exchange and correlation. token/epoch are application deadline or resource-generation data, not a second scheduler. events is a nonblocking owner-local observation sink, never a synchronous call into another Message. Physical timer/lifecycle/native adapters remain REQUIRE_IMPLEMENTATION. LMX parser/type/runtime: NOT_RUN. native.submit(token,value,selfAddress):int is a narrow L2/host boundary: one admits and zero rejects without launching. It copies input, retains resources and returns immediately. Blocking I/O, C API locks and OS waits run outside the Message owner in the selected native executor/process. completed is posted after the native call returns and its holds are released, never as a reentrant submit callback. releaseIdle runs only after the last completion. c.* and physical synchronization remain L2. Admission is not job success.

BlockingClientMessage:
    int: value
    i64: token
    int: ok
    @: native
    @: selfAddress
    @: lifecycle
    @: events
    private: int: phase 0
    private: int: active 0
    private: i64: next 0
    private: i64: current 0
    submit:
        if: node\phase != 0 || node\active = 1
            events\rejected(1)
            return
        if: node\next = 9223372036854775807
            events\rejected(2)
            return
        node\next += 1
        node\current := node\next
        node\active := 1
        private: int: admitted native\submit(node\current; value; selfAddress)
        if: admitted != 1
            node\active := 0
            events\rejected(3)
    completed:
        if: node\active = 0 || token != node\current
            return
        node\active := 0
        events\finished(token; ok; value)
        if: node\phase = 1
            finishClose()
    beginClose:
        if: node\phase != 0
            return
        node\phase := 1
        if: node\active = 0
            finishClose()
    finishClose:
        if: node\phase != 1 || node\active != 0
            return
        native\releaseIdle()
        node\phase := 2
        events\closed()
        lifecycle\requestOwnerClose()
    query:
        events\status(node\phase; node\active)

listings.notes_ru: Полный process loop и worker invocation. Call обязан использовать внешний port или корректно dirty-scheduled NIF. Обычные exceptions превращаются в failure; неконтролируемая гибель процесса/VM требует отдельного host failure signal.
listings.notes_en: Complete ordinary process loop and worker invocation; Call must be an external port-backed operation or an appropriately scheduled dirty NIF. Normal exceptions become failure. An uncatchable process/VM termination is outside the bounded fixture and requires host failure signaling.
